info.description: The Loyalty Balance Retrieval API allows clients to access and view the loyalty balances associated with customer accounts. This endpoint is essential for businesses aiming to enhance customer engagement by providing real-time information about loyalty rewards. Typical consumers of this API include customer service representatives and customer-facing applications that facilitate account management. By utilizing this endpoint, businesses can inform their users about available loyalty points, encouraging them to participate in loyalty programs.

get.description: This endpoint allows users to fetch their current loyalty balance, providing insights into their rewards status. Ideal for customers looking to check their available points or rewards.

requestBody.description: This request retrieves the loyalty balance for a user. It requires the appropriate user authentication and provides the necessary details to fetch the current balance associated with the user's loyalty account.

ListLoyaltyLoyaltyBalancesRequest.description: A string representing the request body for getting loyalty balance information.
